records.jp: よーし、せっかく作ったナイトプール……<CR>遊び倒すぞー！！
records.en_original: Time to get our money's worth out of this pool!
records.en: All right, since we went to the trouble of making this night pool...<CR>let us play here until we drop!!

records.jp: んじゃまずは何する？
とにかく泳ぎまくろうぜ！
いいねいいね！　よ～し、レッツゴー！
うおおおおおお！
うああああああ！
やっぱここは水のかけ合いっしょ！
カップル的なヤツ？
そう、カップル的なヤツ！
オッケー、やろうかハニー
キャッキャッ！
ウフフ！
いや～ナイトプール楽しいね～
うん～たのしい～
これじゃ、いつもと一緒じゃね？
records.en_original: This isn't very different from a regular pool, is it?
records.en: This isn't very different from a regular pool, is it?

records.jp: それな。<CR>普段のプールでやってることとまるで変わらん
records.en_original: You're right. Everything we've done we would've done at a regular pool too.
records.en: You're right.<CR>Everything we've done we would've done at a regular pool too.

records.jp: そんなのやだやだ！！<CR>もっとナイトプールだけの遊びがしたいよ！！
records.en_original: That's no good at all! We need a game you can only do at a night pool!
records.en: That's no good at all!<CR>We need a game you can only do at a night pool!

records.jp: 何かないの愛央！？
……綺麗だけど、これって遊びかな？
records.en_original: It's pretty, but...does this count as a game?
records.en: It's pretty, but...does this count as a game?

records.jp: うーん、多分違う
何これどういう遊び！？
records.en_original: What kind of game is this?!
records.en: What kind of game is this?!

records.jp: わからん！！　ごめん！！
――はっ！
そうか……普段のプールでするようなことを、<CR>しなければいいんだ！！
records.en_original: I see... So we just have to make sure it's something you definitely wouldn't do at a normal pool!
records.en: I see... So we just have to make sure it's something you definitely<CR>wouldn't do at a normal pool!

records.jp: それはわかってるけど、何をすればいいのか……
records.en_original: I know that, but what could we do...
records.en: I know that, but what could we do...

records.jp: ってまさか！！
そう、普段は泳ぎまくるなら、<CR>ナイトプールでは泳ぎまくら――
records.en_original: In a normal pool you'd swim a bunch, which would mean...
records.en: In a normal pool you'd swim<CR>a bunch, which would mean...

records.jp: 逆転の発想だ！！
ってことは、水もかけ合わ――
て、天才だーーー！！
あれ、待てよ……ということはつまり<CR>水にも入ら……
records.en_original: Which means... Do we even get in the pool...?
records.en: Which means... Do we even get in<CR>the pool...?

records.jp: 良くそこに気付いたねガール
そう、水にもはいらない！！！
うおおおおっ！
よおおおっし！　理論を理解したところで<CR>ナイトプールを楽しむぞ！
records.en_original: All right! Now that we've got that figured out, it's time to enjoy this night pool!
records.en: All right! Now that we've got that figured out, it's<CR>time to enjoy this night pool!

records.jp: ひゃっほおおお！！
ナイトプール……つまんないね
うん……水に入りたいよ……普通に
records.en_original: I wanna get in the water...
records.en: I wanna get in the water...

records.jp: ごめんね愛央……<CR>あたしが作りたいって言ったのに、何も知らなくて……
records.en_original: I'm sorry, Ao... I was the one who said we should build it. I had no idea it would be like this...
records.en: I'm sorry, Ao... I was<CR>the one who said we should build it. I had no idea it would be like this...

records.jp: 謝る必要なんてないよ
records.en_original: You have nothing to apologize for.
records.en: You have nothing to apologize for.

records.jp: ナイトプールを作って、勇希と普通に遊んで、<CR>勇希と馬鹿やって……
records.en_original: Making the pool together and hanging out with you...
records.en: We built a night pool, I played normally with you,<CR>and we fooled around together...

records.jp: 私すっごい楽しかったもん
records.en_original: I had a ton of fun.
records.en: I had a ton of fun.

records.jp: だからその機会をくれたナイトプールも、<CR>提案してくれた勇希も、最高じゃん？
records.en_original: So I'm super glad we got to build it, and I'm glad that you suggested it.
records.en: So both the night pool that gave us that chance<CR>and you, who suggested it, are the best, right?

records.jp: て、照れるなあもう！
records.en_original: Gaaah, you're gonna make me blush!
records.en: Gaaah, you're gonna make me blush!

records.jp: ふふふ。以上、愛央ちゃんのマジ慰めでした。<CR>じゃあもうちょい普通に遊びますか！
records.en_original: Hehehe. Just wanted to let you know. Let's have some more fun!
records.en: Hehehe. And that was Ao-chan's serious attempt at comforting<CR>you. Now let's play a little more normally!

records.jp: 見て、勇希！　この星空も、<CR>ナイトプールも、キラキラに輝いてるでしょ！？
records.en_original: Look, Yuki! Look at how magical the sky and pool are!
records.en: Look, Yuki! Both this starry sky<CR>and the night pool are sparkling, right!?

records.jp: ということはつまり、キラキラに挟まれた私たちも<CR>キラキラだっていうこと！！
records.en_original: And we're right in the middle of it all!
records.en: Which means that we, caught between all that sparkle,<CR>are sparkling too!!

records.jp: だから特別な遊び方なんてしなくたって、<CR>何も知らなくたっていいんだ！！
records.en_original: We don't have to do anything special!
records.en: So we do not need a special way to play,<CR>and it is fine if we do not know anything about night pools!!

records.jp: だって私たちはここにいるだけでキラキラなんだから！
records.en_original: Everything we do here is magical!
records.en: Because we sparkle simply by being here!

records.jp: そっか、あたしたちは普通にしてればよかったんだ……<CR>なんだか、ずいぶん遠回りをしちゃったね……
records.en_original: So we can just do whatever we want... Seems like we got pretty off track.
records.en: I see. We only had to act normally...<CR>It feels like we took quite a long detour...

records.jp: 大丈夫、その遠回りすらもキラキラだよ。<CR>私たちにはナイトプールがあるからね
records.en_original: That's okay. That's just part of the magic too. We still have the night pool.
records.en: It is fine. Even that detour sparkles.<CR>Because we have the night pool.

records.jp: うおおおおっ！
ナイトプールさいこおおおお！！
フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
